conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, holding a larger cash buffer. Expect lower potential upside but also much smaller potential losses.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month by leaning into leverage and concentration, including leveraged ETFs. Expect higher potential upside but also significantly larger potential drawdowns and amplified losses due to leverage and daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

income.read: This plan focuses on generating steady monthly income with a target of around 1% per month. It eliminates leverage and high-beta single names, shifting capital towards income-generating ETFs like QQQI. Expect lower growth potential but a more stable, income-focused portfolio with reduced volatility.
